## A percentage of the current value {#fm5-finish .fm-slide }

Growth uses a multiplier **greater than 1**.

Depreciation uses a multiplier **between 0 and 1**.

::: {.takeaway}
I can choose a suitable model to calculate investment interest or an asset’s depreciated value.
:::

**Exit check:** explain why a 14% annual loss does not remove the same number of dollars each year.

::: notes
Expected explanation: the current value becomes smaller, so 14% of that value becomes smaller. Invite comparison with constant-dollar loss without changing the model of the source example.
:::
